Time-to-event summary

Source: R/builders-table.R
tbl_tte.Rd

Kaplan-Meier median time with 95% CI per arm. With two or more arms it adds Cox hazard ratios versus the first arm and the log-rank p-value as footnotes. ADaM ADTTE conventions apply: AVAL is the time and CNSR == 1 means censored. Requires the survival package.

Usage

tbl_tte(adx, trt_var = "TRT01A", paramcd = NULL, config = NULL)

Arguments

adx

A BDS dataset (AVISIT, optionally AVISITN and PARAMCD).

trt_var

Treatment variable (resolved with tlf_resolve_trt()).

paramcd

Optional PARAMCD filter.

config

A tlf_config(); NULL resolves through tlf_get_config().

Value

A tlf_table.

See also

Other table builders: tbl_ae(), tbl_ae_severity(), tbl_demographics(), tbl_disposition(), tbl_eff(), tbl_listing(), tbl_shift()

Examples

if (requireNamespace("survival", quietly = TRUE)) tbl_tte(ex_adtte)
#> <tlf_table> 3 row(s) x 4 column(s)
#>  Statistic            Drug 10 mg (N=20) Drug 20 mg (N=20)   Placebo (N=20)     
#>  Subjects, n          20                20                  20                 
#>  Events, n (%)        7 (35.0%)         9 (45.0%)           13 (65.0%)         
#>  Median time (95% CI) NE (309.00, NE)   311.00 (118.00, NE) 291.00 (207.00, NE)
#> Note: Hazard ratio (95% CI), Drug 20 mg vs Drug 10 mg: 1.60 (0.60, 4.31)
#> Note: Hazard ratio (95% CI), Placebo vs Drug 10 mg: 1.89 (0.75, 4.74)
#> Note: Log-rank p-value: 0.387
